rules.retireWhen: Studio color tokens carry a Property: Color term, or design-data no longer requires property on palette colors.
rules.notes: Studio classifies primitive colors by Color family and Scale index only. design-data requires property on every name.

rules.retireWhen: Studio spacing tokens carry an explicit Property term.
rules.notes: Fills design-data's required property when a Studio spacing token has none.

rules.retireWhen: Studio size tokens carry an explicit Property term.
rules.notes: Fills design-data's required property when a Studio size token has none.

rules.retireWhen: Studio radius tokens carry an explicit Property term.
rules.notes: Fills design-data's required property when a Studio radius token has none.

rules.retireWhen: Studio elevation tokens carry an explicit Property term.
rules.notes: Fills design-data's required property when a Studio elevation token has none.

rules.retireWhen: Studio opacity tokens carry an explicit Property term.
rules.notes: Fills design-data's required property when a Studio opacity token has none.

rules.retireWhen: design-data property-terms registry uses the Studio spellings, or Studio adopts the design-data ids.
rules.notes: Studio Property terms use spaced display values; design-data uses hyphenated ids. Studio uses Drop shadow because Attribute already owns Shadow.

rules.retireWhen: Studio's Orientation category key is orientation.
Studio's weight term value is regular.
rules.notes: Applied before the key rename in XW-010.

rules.retireWhen: Studio's font weight category key is weight.
Studio and design-data share one size vocabulary.
rules.notes: Studio uses full words; the design-data sizes registry uses abbreviated ids.

rules.retireWhen: No saved Studio data uses the legacy colorName key.
rules.notes: Legacy Studio key kept only for older saved names.

rules.retireWhen: No saved Studio data uses the legacy contrastValue key.
rules.notes: Legacy Studio key kept only for older saved names.

rules.retireWhen: No Studio name stores scaleIndex as text.
rules.notes: Whole-number text such as "100" becomes the number 100.

rules.retireWhen: design-data adopts a rendering-behavior field, or Studio stops naming tokens with it.
rules.notes: Comparison only. Output names keep the field so emitted names stay unique.

rules.retireWhen: design-data adopts a mode-behavior field, or Studio stops naming tokens with it.
rules.notes: Comparison only. Output names keep the field so emitted names stay unique.

rules.retireWhen: design-data palette tokens publish high-contrast rows.
rules.notes: design-data palette rows omit contrast, which means its declared default (regular). Studio high-contrast rows are extra variants, not failed matches.

rules.retireWhen: design-data field schema records allowed tiers, including Semantic for scaleIndex.
rules.notes: Color-role scales such as accent-color-100 keep the step number that design-data already publishes on semantic palette tokens.
